intent: Three focused drawing alternatives for critic-r16B-3

prompts.a: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: pixel-art fog overlay tile, 192x192 native pixels shown enlarged. This is a focused drawing repair on the provided hard-alpha fog tile. Keep the exact square canvas, native pixel size, solid pure magenta #FF00FF clear background and existing flat palette (#ad bfc5 interpreted as #ADBFC5, #C8D6D8, #E1E8E6). Preserve the broad calm grey bank planes, and preserve the outermost 6 native pixels along all four edges exactly to keep the approved matching edges. Redraw the conspicuous small capped/arched cloud in the lower right (native x139-186,y110-149): replace its compact hump and bright cap with a much shallower irregular low bank, interleaved broken flat layers, no closed oval, arch or cloud crest. Also redraw the bright stepped upper-left bank (native x6-78,y12-40): replace the recognizable white crest with quiet irregular low horizontal planes and an uneven branching clear gap. Recompose some nearby interior clear space to stop a repeated arrangement of two humps reading as rows. No identifiable compact landmarks. No diagonal chain, no regular spacing, no smears, haze blur, noise, isolated specks, thin scratches. Keep 40-50 percent fog coverage and broad map-readable magenta gaps. All fog is flat discrete square pixel clusters, no rounded corners, no antialiasing or dithering, subtly lit upper left, quiet blue grey one-pixel contour only. Variant A: quiet shallow overlapping planes with only small non-arched pale accents. Draw the complete edited tile once, no labels, no grid, no montage. Return a large square image.
prompts.b: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided enlarged 192x192 pixel-art fog overlay tile on solid pure magenta. Variant B of a focused redraw. Preserve square canvas, scale of square pixels, outermost six native pixel rows/columns EXACTLY, and the big quiet grey shapes through the middle. Primary change: draw out the two recognizable white cloud crests, the upper-left cluster at native x6..78 y12..40 and lower-right capped cloud at x139..186 y110..149. These must become VERY QUIET shallow irregular overlapping fog shelves, WITHOUT ANY WHITE CAP, arch, dome, loop, compact cloudy hump or recognizable icon. Mostly use the existing base pale blue-grey #ADBFC5 and gentle #C8D6D8, with almost no #E1E8E6 inside those two regions. Let two or three long uneven low planes slide past each other; offset the ends, vary their heights. Also redraw the nearby magenta gap shapes to break the repeated bright/clear row arrangement. Magenta gaps still occupy 50-60% of total tile. Preserve the broad successful central fog planes and avoid adding a new focal landmark. Flat crisp pixel clusters, subtly top-left light, one native pixel quiet grey contour. No rounded edges, no blur, no airbrush, no gradients, noise, dithering, thin scratches or isolated specks. Magenta #FF00FF stays exactly solid. Large single square image, no text, no grid, no montage.
prompts.c: Use case: precise-object-edit. Single square pixel-art fog tile on solid #FF00FF magenta. Third alternative C. Use provided image as exact layout to repair. It represents 192x192 native pixels at enlarged scale. Keep outermost 6 native pixels on all four sides and preserve the successful broad central grey planes. REDRAW the two bad cloud motifs: upper left native x6-78,y12-40, lower right native x135-186,y108-151. Paint very shallow staggered flat fog strata into each, in the base #ADBFC5 and a little gentle #C8D6D8. Eliminate the compact mound silhouette and bright arched cap completely. Lower right should be a much wider, lower, irregular broken shelf entering from right with a long low left extension around native y134, a small separate upper shelf around y115, and uneven magenta channels between. Upper left should have asymmetric quiet overlapping flat planes with a magenta inlet reaching from the right, without a bright center or rounded crest. Deliberately flatten the height and elongate the painted contours, while keeping the outer border unchanged. Each flat plane's ends offset and partly overlap, no repeated regular horizontal stripe pattern. These are gentle fog banks, not clouds, mountains, icons or waves. Keep large irregular magenta clear areas, total fog cover about 40-50%. Top-left lighting only faint, no bright local focal points in repaired areas. Strict square pixels of the same scale, thin subdued outline, no rounded corners, blur, gradients, tiny disconnected specks or scratches. Do not simply recolor the old cap: draw new shallow contours and new negative-space channels. Solid magenta clear background, one complete image, no text or borders.
